convention.units: integer DBU; gdstk returns microns and the conversion happens once here
convention.model: global = R * local + origin, R = diag(sx, sy), sx/sy in {+1,-1}

anchor_semantics.what_the_gds_origin_is: an anchor, not a lower-left corner: a kind with sx=-1 anchors at the cell right edge, sy=-1 at the top edge
anchor_semantics.note: the 275 shared anchors are pairs occupying adjacent space; their bboxes overlap only in the 0.19 um implant overhang

footprint_source.note: one master carries no footprint marker; its footprint is its bbox inset by the inset the other masters agree on
